system.description: You throw a handful of seeds in the air that ignite and speed toward a target within long range, scorching the air with twisting smoke trails. A successful attack deals 3 damage and catches the target on fire, inflicting +1 damage per round until the target uses an action to douse the flames or until you've taken your next recovery. Action.
